name: Deep Panda APT Group Uses Milestone Backdoor to Exploit Log4Shell Bug in VMware Horizon Servers
description:
Researchers detected a campaign by Deep Panda, a Chinese APT group that exploited the Log4Shell bug in VMware Horizon servers. Following exploitation, Deep Panda deployed a backdoor on the infected devices.  

Affected platforms
Windows.

Victims
The nature of targeting was opportunistic insofar that multiple infections in many countries and various sectors occurred on the same dates. The victims belong to the financial, academic, cosmetics, and travel industries.

name: New Milestones for Deep Panda: Log4Shell and Digitally Signed Fire Chili Rootkits
description: FortiEDR, a security firm based in London, has identified a new type of cyber-attack from a Chinese nation-state threat group, Deep Panda, which exploited a vulnerability in VMware Horizon servers.

name: APT19.APT - Malware Domain Feed V2
description: Command and Control domains for APT19.APT. These domains are extracted from a number of sources, and are suspicious.

name: Analyzing APT19 Derusbi Malware Using a Step-by-Step Method
description: This blog post presents a full analysis of a DLL backdoor also reported publicly as Derusbi. This particular piece of malware is associated with the actor known as APT19 (Codoso, C0d0so, Deep Panda, Sunshop Group).

name: Deep Panda FBI Flash Alert
description:
Krebs' republishing of TLP Green FBI Flash Alert on Pulses.

Note the Related Pulses on the OPM Breach Analysis and Anthem. A similar C&C structure and set of malware used in both attacks and Deep Panda are indicative of Deep Panda's involvement in both attacks.
